description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the NationalityService, testing various methods such as getting a list of nationalities, retrieving by ID, deleting, and retrieving by name. It sets up mock objects and uses test data fixtures to verify functionality.

classes.name: NationalityServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the NationalityService class methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating a new instance of NationalityService and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests the getNationalityList method of NationalityService to ensure it returns the expected list of Nationality objects.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a nationality by its ID using getNationalityById.

methods.name: testDeleteNationalities
methods.description: Tests the deletion of multiple nationalities via deleteNationalities method.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a nationality by its name via getNationalityByName.
